name: Csengőd (Hungary)
description: Yellow-green field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Csengőd (a shield of green, white and yellow with a bell, a bunch of grapes and a vine leaf) above the name CSENGŐD in green.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
